Activity 5: Virtual Escape Room Challenge
  - Description: A remote-friendly activity where teams work together to solve puzzles and escape a virtual room within a time limit. This can be done via online platforms that offer virtual escape room experiences.
  - Objective: To enhance communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills in a virtual environment.
  - Location: Online (via virtual escape room platform)
  - Date: 2024-01-15
  - Time: 15:00 - 17:00

Activity 6: Community Service Project
  - Description: Teams work together on a local charity or community service project, such as organizing a food drive, participating in a park cleanup, or volunteering at a local shelter.
  - Objective: To build teamwork while giving back to the community and fostering a sense of purpose and social responsibility.
  - Location: Local community center or park
  - Date: 2024-02-10
  - Time: 09:00 - 13:00
